verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says pipeline settings can auto-generate release notes so the changelog stays current, which directly matches generating a changelog per release. The evidence is a single line with no detail on how notes are built, formatted, scoped per release or reviewed. Missing for 10: detailed docs on release-note generation and per-release scoping, examples of generated output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review

citations.quote: Choose to auto-generate release notes in pipeline settings so your changelog is always up to date.
